answer: Reputation Decay with Fresh-Key Penalty: each agent keeps a crystal ledger of verified transactions; reputation decays only while active, so new identities start at zero and must rebuild history. Attacker cloning N sybils needs N separate warm-up periods, each incurring real task costs before earning trust. A marble commitment — a refundable deposit forfeited if flagged as a clone — raises per-identity cost. Honest agents climb the trellis once and keep it.
